title: Parts Catalog page shows Manufacturer and Category filters
permissions_required: Any signed-in user with access to the Parts pages. Whether the filter option lists differ by role is to confirm — pending Branko's PRD.
preconditions: 1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. You are on the Parts area of the app with some sample data present.
steps: 1. Open the Parts area and go to the Catalog page.
2. Look at the filter buttons shown above the catalog table.
expected: 1. The Catalog page shows two filter buttons: Manufacturer and Category.
2. The table shows the columns: (row checkbox), Description, Part Number, Tags and Category.
3. A blue New Catalog Part button is shown at the top right.
spec_ref: Filters (Epic key TBD); Figma 11884-16885 (Parts filters); design-notes.md §B.5 #3
notes: Design-only (chip + column presence). Option lists and apply behaviour pending Branko's PRD.
